dict.string: Temper saves each Workout to Health when it ends.
Temper reads your heart rate during a Workout on Apple Watch, and your date of birth and resting heart rate to work out heart-rate zones.
Temper listens while you describe a Workout, and writes down what you say. Your words stay on your iPhone.
Temper turns what you say into words on your iPhone, so it can make a Plan from them.
